name: Iowa engineering benchmark / 工程验收参数包
region: Reference weather near 42 N, 93.5 W; not the chosen business pilot

crops.name: Dry field pea / 干籽豌豆（benchmark）

KSTATE_CORN.title: K-State: Corn Maturity
KSTATE_CORN.applicability: Example 110-day hybrid; 2670 Fahrenheit degree-days / 1.8 = Celsius degree-days.
limitations: Kansas extension example; not an Iowa cultivar calibration. Physiological maturity is not a validated harvest/drying schedule.

FAO56_KC.title: FAO-56 Chapter 6, Table 12
FAO56_KC.applicability: Standard non-stressed crop coefficients; field maize high-moisture harvest, oats, dry peas.
limitations: General standard coefficients need climate/wetting and local crop adjustment; stage timing is a separate benchmark assumption.

SARE_FAMILY.title: Crop Rotation on Organic Farms, crop-family diagrams (local reader pp.56–58)
SARE_FAMILY.applicability: Grass family Poaceae and legume family Fabaceae; server-owned crop mapping.
limitations: Botanical family is not a pathogen diagnosis or a universal required interval.

B_PHENOLOGY.title: Engineering benchmark phenology settings
B_PHENOLOGY.applicability: Illustrative oat/pea thermal thresholds and temperature bounds; crop duration caps.
limitations: No cultivar validation; no frost damage, photoperiod or vernalization model. Do not use as a planting recommendation.

B_CALENDAR.title: Engineering benchmark sowing and turnaround calendar
B_CALENDAR.applicability: Narrow spring windows; a 14-day post-harvest occupancy allowance.
limitations: Not a locally verified sowing calendar or machinery schedule.

B_STAGES.title: Engineering benchmark stage fractions
B_STAGES.applicability: Initial/development/mid/late fractions 0.2/0.3/0.3/0.2 over computed growing duration.
limitations: Not observed crop phenology; FAO coefficient values do not validate these stage timings.

B_RESOURCES.title: Engineering benchmark cost and labour
B_RESOURCES.applicability: Illustrative USD/ha and labour-days/ha, allocated uniformly across growing days.
limitations: Not current market prices or a farm budget; excludes yield/revenue, drying, and machinery constraints.

B_RAIN.title: Engineering benchmark effective rainfall
B_RAIN.applicability: 80% of daily rain is credited; positive daily Kc*ET0 minus credited rain is the supplemental gap.
limitations: No root-zone storage, runoff, drainage, carry-over or irrigation-efficiency model. Not an irrigation prescription.

B_GAPS.title: Engineering benchmark family interval
B_GAPS.applicability: 365-day gap for Poaceae and Fabaceae, plus no identical adjacent crops.
limitations: Not a universal disease break period; local crop/pathogen advice may require different rules.

B_OBJECTIVE.title: Engineering benchmark objective and sampling
B_OBJECTIVE.applicability: Fixed positive metric reference scales, user preference defaults, 14-day sowing sampling, and 25 km benchmark locality guard.
limitations: Only optimal for this candidate set and objective; neither profit maximization nor locally calibrated farming advice.
Engineering benchmark, not locally calibrated agricultural advice.
Historical 2025 weather is replayed with source dates; it is not a forecast.
No yield, profit, nutrient balance, frost damage or soil-storage prediction.
No-irrigation constraints use a conservative simplified gap; infeasibility does not establish that rainfed farming is impossible.
Crop maturity is thermal and capped; local cultivar, soil and management validation is required.
